notes: Hex strings are uppercase, no separators, wire order. 'source' = 'legacy-test' (ported verbatim from the existing automated tests), 'derived' (computed by the specified algorithm; not in the legacy tests), or 'synthetic' (constructed for coverage; not a device capture).
Input is one reassembled frame. Accept only if: length >= 33, bytes[0..1] = 55 AA, byte[5] = 0x17, last two bytes = 0D 0A, declared length (bytes 6-7 LE) <= 4096 and declared+10 == frame length.
speedKph = (byte24 | byte25<<8) / 100.0 * 1.60934   (hundredths of mph -> km/h). inclinePercent = byte30 / 10.0 (unsigned).

rejects.reason: command byte 0x16 is not status 0x17 (and too short)
